entities.name: Alliances
entities.description: A planned but unreleased ARMADA comic continuing the story of Jaeuhl Carthalion and Kaysa after the World Spell.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: Knight of Kjeldor who grows up, leads the Juniper Order Advocates and has a child with Kaysa.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: Ley Druid who becomes the new Elder Druid and leads Elves to Yavimaya.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Descendant of Jaeuhl and Kaysa bearing the Elder Druid birthmark.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Planeswalker who turns away Taysir's proposal.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: Planeswalker who falls in love with Kristina and later pursues vengeance.

entities.name: Nailah
entities.description: Dark sorceress who placed a ban on Taysir.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Enchanted forest inhabited by a malign sentience, where the Elves settle.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent reduced to an archipelago by flooding.

entities.name: Juniper Order Advocates
entities.description: Knightly order of Kjeldor dedicated to ties with the Elves, led by Jaeuhl.

entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: War whose tragic events follow from the Kristina-Taysir flash point.

events.summary: Flooding and storms ravage Dominaria as the Ice Age ends; Soldev is crushed by artifact creatures.
events.quote: the city of Soldev is crushed by rampaging artifact creatures

events.summary: Elves led by Kaysa and Jaeuhl escape to the Yavimaya forest.
events.quote: a convoy of Elves escape to the Yavimaya forest

events.summary: Peace is made with the Yavimayan apes, the Elves settle, and Jaeuhl and Kaysa have a child.
events.quote: Jaeuhl and Kaysa have a child, and the Carthalion lineage continues

events.summary: Terisiare is reduced to an archipelago when the floods end.
events.quote: Terisiare is reduced to an extensive archipelago

events.summary: Taysir confesses his love and asks Kristina to marry him.
events.quote: He has fallen in love with her, his constant traveling companion

events.summary: Kristina turns Taysir away and he turns to vengeance against Leshrac and Tevesh Szat.
events.quote: she has no choice but to turn him away

relations.quote: the druid Kaysa has grown up to fall in love with none other than that wayward Knight of Kjeldor , Jaeuhl Carthalion
Their descendant Jared Carthalion bears Kaysa's crescent-shaped birthmark
He has fallen in love with her, his constant traveling companion
spurred on by his new spellsquire Ravidel
now the leader of the Juniper Order Advocates
